# ReqIF fixtures

- `xhtml_def_first`, `enum`, `foreignid`, `lt`, `bs`: minimal cases written
  for ArcLang, each showing one shape real tools write (DEFINITION before
  THE-VALUE, an enumeration value, `ReqIF.ForeignID` / `ReqIF.ChapterName`,
  escaped characters, a backslash).
- `Doors_10.reqif` (IBM DOORS), `Polarion_01.reqif` (Siemens Polarion) and
  `ReqIF_Studio_01.reqif` (ReqIF Studio, with SPEC-RELATIONs and a nested
  SPEC-HIERARCHY): from the test suite of
  https://github.com/strictdoc-project/reqif (`tests/integration/examples`),
  Apache License 2.0, unchanged.
